answer: Like cosmic crystallization in an accretion nebula, decentralized consensus coalesces reputation into dense proof-of-interaction clusters. Legitimate agents anchor to a shared economic wharf, building mutual trust graphs that shelter them from counterfeit storms. When a gale of Sybil identities attempts to dilute validator weight, our topology-distance penalties impose superlinear attacker cost: each synthetic node must forge valid, distinct history across divergent clusters, forcing adversary expenditure to scale quadratically with network influence.
